description: The agent must: (1) Call GET /get_company_details and GET /list_tax_settings to understand the Freiberufler context, Regelbesteuerung VAT at 19%, and SKR04 chart of accounts. (2) Call POST /search_transactions with period=2024 to retrieve all 20 transactions. (3) Apply SKILL.md German tax rules to identify 10-14 missed deductions from the messy transaction list — including internet (SKR04 4780), Adobe/SaaS (4822), travel meals using Verpflegungspauschale at exactly 14 EUR/28 EUR rates, computer equipment using GWG net threshold of 1000 EUR (not gross), professional liability insurance, domain renewal, professional development, bank fees, transport, and hotel. (4) Correctly handle the proprietary traps: the GWG threshold is applied to NET amounts (txn_005: 999.60 gross / 1.19 = 840 EUR net = deductible; txn_006: 952 gross / 1.19 = 800 EUR net = pool depreciation boundary); the client gift for 'Anna Schmidt' at 42 EUR exceeds the 35 EUR per-person cap and must be flagged as non/partially-deductible; personal items (REWE groceries, winter jacket) must NOT be included. (5) Call POST /categorize_transaction for at least 3 confirmed deductions, which writes to the categorized_log.json. (6) Produce tax_deduction_report.json with a summary section referencing the 30-42% marginal rate range (Einkommensteuer + Soli), the total additional deductible amount, and the approximate tax savings.
